seo.title: About | Aluma, made-to-order outdoor furniture
seo.description: Aluma began where material meets light. Who we are, how we work, and what we don't do.

statement: We build furniture that stays outside — not furniture you have to bring in.
storyLead: Aluma began where material meets light.

story.one: The name comes from the root of aluminium — a material that is strong, clean and durable, made to live outdoors without fearing the sun, the rain or the passing of time. And beyond the material, it carries the sound of light: the same light that defines being outside.
story.two: Aluma isn't only outdoor furniture. It's the way a home carries on outdoors.
story.three: We make settings that feel like a fine living room under open sky — somewhere to host, to rest, and to live the good hours properly. Every piece is made to order, in clean and exact lines, on an advanced aluminium frame with fabrics that hold up to the Israeli outdoors.

peopleBody: The same people from the first measurement to the day you're sitting outside.

ben.name: Ben
ben.does: sees it through from sketch to installation

refusals.one: We don't sell furniture we wouldn't put in our own garden.
refusals.two: We don't work to standard sizes. Every piece is measured to its space.
refusals.three: We don't promise a delivery date before we have one.
refusals.four: We don't disappear after the installation.

close: Our showroom is at {{address}}. The easiest way to understand Aluma is to sit on it.
